They recorded an album that they believed was going to secure his reputation as one of the greatest recording artists of his generation. In fact, the album bombed and the singer disappeared into obscurity amid rumours of a gruesome on-stage suicide. But a bootleg recording found its way into apartheid South Africa and, over the next two decades, it became a phenomenon. Two South African fans then set out to find out what really happened to their hero. Their investigation led them to a story more extraordinary than any of the existing myths about the artist known as Rodriguez. This is a film about hope, inspiration and the resonating power of music.

programme.desc: In the late ‘60s, a musician was discovered in a Detroit bar by two celebrated producers who were struck by his soulful melodies and prophetic lyrics. They recorded an album that they believed was going to secure his reputation as one of the greatest recording artists of his generation. In fact, the album bombed and the singer disappeared into obscurity amid rumours of a gruesome on-stage suicide. But a bootleg recording found its way into apartheid South Africa and, over the next two decades, it became a phenomenon. Two South African fans then set out to find out what really happened to their hero. Their investigation led them to a story more extraordinary than any of the existing myths about the artist known as Rodriguez. This is a film about hope, inspiration and the resonating power of music.

They recorded an album that they believed was going to secure his reputation as one of the greatest recording artists of his generation. In fact, the album bombed and the singer disappeared into obscurity amid rumours of a gruesome on-stage suicide. But a bootleg recording found its way into apartheid South Africa and, over the next two decades, it became a phenomenon. Two South African fans then set out to find out what really happened to their hero. Their investigation led them to a story more extraordinary than any of the existing myths about the artist known as Rodriguez. They recorded an album that they believed was going to secure his reputation as one of the greatest recording artists of his generation. In fact, the album bombed and the singer disappeared into obscurity amid rumours of a gruesome on-stage suicide. But a bootleg recording found its way into apartheid South Africa and, over the next two decades, it became a phenomenon. Two South African fans then set out to find out what really happened to their hero. Their investigation led them to a story more extraordinary than any of the existing myths about the artist known as Rodriguez. This is a film about hope, inspiration and the resonating power of music.

In fact, the album bombed and the singer disappeared into obscurity amid rumours of a gruesome on-stage suicide. But a bootleg recording found its way into apartheid South Africa and, over the next two decades, it became a phenomenon. Two South African fans then set out to find out what really happened to their hero. In fact, the album bombed and the singer disappeared into obscurity amid rumours of a gruesome on-stage suicide. But a bootleg recording found its way into apartheid South Africa and, over the next two decades, it became a phenomenon. programme.title: Paddock To Plate
programme.desc: Matt's on the road again but this time he's heading to a place he calls his second home-the Orange and Bathurst region of NSW.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: As Rick’s Cornish odyssey comes to an end he takes a city break in Truro, where he discovers an unusual ghost story and tours the magnificent cathedral. Deep in the Cornish countryside is a family passionate about offal who prepare Rick a delicious meal of pickled ox tongue and beef heart tacos.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick Stein launches this series about his home county of Cornwall with a trip back in time to his early days running a nightclub in Padstow.

programme.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty
programme.desc: Buddy Valastro's small Hoboken bakery has expanded into an empire that includes a family-run factory creating thousands of treats and savory items along with mind-blowing custom cakes.

programme.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
programme.desc: All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Adam explores New Zealand’s North Island starting in the majestic kauri forests in the north. He visits Dargaville, the kumara capital of New Zealand, and then a kiwifruit farm in Te Puke. At Rotorua he is invited to a traditional Maori ‘Hāngi’ and then joins an impromptu game of rugby. After visiting a farm running shorthorn cattle, Adam heads to the coast to experience another New Zealand tradition, the ‘bach’, a modest holiday shack. A dish of roast Shorthorn beef with kawakawa on the deck overlooking the ocean is a perfect end to his North Island trip.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Cattle are an important part of the grassland's ecosystem. Jenn meets with two ranchers and a chef as she follows this nutrient-dense ingredient from the pasture to the plate.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.desc: Enjoy the culinary skills of Veronica Francis, who draws on her Malaysian influences from her father.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael makes a smoky, Asian-inspired barbeque sauce to slather over Sockeye Salmon cooked with crispy breadcrumbs and green onions, served with white Basmati rice.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura kicks off the show by cooking a delicious Kids Pizza for Mike followed by traditional Anzac Biscuits with John the Fruiterers approval. To round off the show Mike changes stall holder Joanne.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia takes a moment to remind the viewer how important it is to treat yourself to something nice.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatan's once thriving henequen industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motulenos. Pati meets Dona Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe. She also experiences the legacy of henequen at Hacienda Tamchen and encounters another egg dish in the kitchen, where chef Julio Dominguez makes Abuela's Buttoned Eggs.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: Rooted in thrift and creativity, this episode celebrates cucina povera- transforming humble ingredients into deeply satisfying soulful dishes.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: In a beautiful house in the Adelaide Hills, chef Salvatore Pepe cooks perfect bistecca served with white beans. Guy shares his recipe for fresh pasta and Andrew Cibej makes a spinach, ricotta and potato-filled ravioli. Maeve is surrounded by almond blossom in South Australia, visiting Munno Parra Downs, and Guy joins Melbourne sweets queen Marianna Di Bartolo as she folds fresh almonds into her luscious soft nougat.

programme.title: America The Bountiful
programme.desc: Corn is a sacred food for all indigenous tribes of Arizona, including the Tohono O'odham, Yoemi, Navaho and Hopi. Many of the original varieties of corn were lost since the time of colonization.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield

programme.title: Shane Delia's Malta

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Sicily is the largest island in the Mediterranean and has a long history of traditional cheese-making influenced by the Greeks, Romans, and Normans - and of course the Italians. Will looks at the many flavours of Sicilian Pecorino, and visits one of the last farmhouse dairies making a saffron-flavoured cheese from ewe's milk, before finding himself in a Dickensian cheese-maturing room that is several centuries behind the times.

In fact, the album bombed and the singer disappeared into obscurity amid rumours of a gruesome on-stage suicide. But a bootleg recording found its way into apartheid South Africa and, over the next two decades, it became a phenomenon. Two South African fans then set out to find out what really happened to their hero. programme.desc: Rick Stein launches this series about his home county of Cornwall with a trip back in time to his early days running a nightclub in Padstow.

programme.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty

programme.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Adam explores New Zealand’s North Island starting in the majestic kauri forests in the north. He visits Dargaville, the kumara capital of New Zealand, and then a kiwifruit farm in Te Puke. At Rotorua he is invited to a traditional Maori ‘Hāngi’ and then joins an impromptu game of rugby. After visiting a farm running shorthorn cattle, Adam heads to the coast to experience another New Zealand tradition, the ‘bach’, a modest holiday shack. A dish of roast Shorthorn beef with kawakawa on the deck overlooking the ocean is a perfect end to his North Island trip.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Cattle are an important part of the grassland's ecosystem. Jenn meets with two ranchers and a chef as she follows this nutrient-dense ingredient from the pasture to the plate.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.desc: Enjoy the culinary skills of Veronica Francis, who draws on her Malaysian influences from her father.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael makes a smoky, Asian-inspired barbeque sauce to slather over Sockeye Salmon cooked with crispy breadcrumbs and green onions, served with white Basmati rice.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura kicks off the show by cooking a delicious Kids Pizza for Mike followed by traditional Anzac Biscuits with John the Fruiterers approval. To round off the show Mike changes stall holder Joanne.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia takes a moment to remind the viewer how important it is to treat yourself to something nice.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatan's once thriving henequen industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motulenos. Pati meets Dona Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe. She also experiences the legacy of henequen at Hacienda Tamchen and encounters another egg dish in the kitchen, where chef Julio Dominguez makes Abuela's Buttoned Eggs.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: In a beautiful house in the Adelaide Hills, chef Salvatore Pepe cooks perfect bistecca served with white beans. Guy shares his recipe for fresh pasta and Andrew Cibej makes a spinach, ricotta and potato-filled ravioli. Maeve is surrounded by almond blossom in South Australia, visiting Munno Parra Downs, and Guy joins Melbourne sweets queen Marianna Di Bartolo as she folds fresh almonds into her luscious soft nougat.

programme.desc: Corn is a sacred food for all indigenous tribes of Arizona, including the Tohono O'odham, Yoemi, Navaho and Hopi. Many of the original varieties of corn were lost since the time of colonization.
